proofLevels.same-run-cli: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through a real CLI runner configured by the operator.
proofLevels.same-run-full: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through the local product pipeline.
proofLevels.vendor-signed: Vendor-reviewed or vendor-signed artifact for the same scenario contract.
proofLevels.real-customer-field: Anonymized customer-field evidence from a real deployment, not a synthetic benchmark.
proofLevels.planned: Adapter is listed for roadmap tracking only.
